about: Made by tools/art-import/import_art.py. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script.
frameFormat: [page, x, y, w, h, trimX, trimY, fullW, fullH]

move.note: smooth glide; play at any move speed

windup_toss.note: lasts exactly the telegraph (22 ticks). In Guided mode the wind-up holds: hold the last frame (intensity 1). telegraphIntensity: per-frame alpha (0..1) for the telegraph layer. It ramps up through the wind-up and fades smoothly through the first half of the attack (no hard cut). Multiply it into the tinted layer's alpha

toss.note: throws the spool like a yo-yo (the spool flies in code); the arm stays out to catch it

windup_weave.note: lasts exactly the telegraph (26 ticks). In Guided mode the wind-up holds: hold the last frame (intensity 1). telegraphIntensity: per-frame alpha (0..1) for the telegraph layer. It ramps up through the wind-up and fades smoothly through the first half of the attack (no hard cut). Multiply it into the tinted layer's alpha

weave.note: snaps the thread: arms flung down and apart

windup_cloth.note: lasts exactly the telegraph (30 ticks). In Guided mode the wind-up holds: hold the last frame (intensity 1). telegraphIntensity: per-frame alpha (0..1) for the telegraph layer. It ramps up through the wind-up and fades smoothly through the first half of the attack (no hard cut). Multiply it into the tinted layer's alpha

cloth.note: flings the big cloth across the room

loom.note: weaving on its loom, floating higher (loop while its spool pegs are up; it can't be hurt)

stagger.note: dizzy wobble; loop for as long as the stagger lasts

defeat.note: dissolves into light and sparkles (a hopeful 'set free', not a death). The last frame is empty
